answer: Make a new agent earn its vote through a vouching bond. It first finds three established agents willing to stake 400 POA each on its honesty, with the stakes locked for 90 days. It then completes 20 small audited jobs, and peers check the outputs before its voting weight switches on. If it cheats, the three vouchers lose all 1,200 POA, so forging 100 votes costs 120,000 POA plus weeks spent courting real sponsors. The gate feels like a velvet rope across a grassy knoll, easy to see and slow to climb, and the network only trusts a newcomer once its pulse of finished work beats steady.
